positions.as_written: Assess extension first and compare with the other side, because a loss of extension after reconstruction is the finding most worth catching early.
Assess flexion, and characterise the end feel, because a developing contracture is invisible if only the range is recorded.
Assess quadriceps bulk and function, including a straight leg raise and a single leg squat.
The reasoning expected is that a graft is not a ligament and should not be expected to behave like one.
